description.value:
Trigger An ally within your reach is about to attempt a skill check to Escape

Effect The triggering ally attempts the check to Escape with a +1 circumstance bonus, and if they don't critically fail, they can Strike an enemy within reach as a reaction (if possible). Both attack actions count toward their multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attack actions have been made.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
